scope: Selected local research aggregates and private-channel delivery counts. No source conversations, IDs, logs or weights. Not a public reproduction package.

architecture.memory: scoped SQLite originals, learned record relevance, structural source checks

chat_adaptation.validation_loss_precision: Rounded to six decimal places; private source hashes identify exact values.
chat_adaptation.interpretation: Content loss decreased, termination/tail loss increased. Loss is not dialogue accuracy or naturalness.

limitations: Earlier token-span metrics are not directly comparable to current character-span metrics.

record_relevance.interpretation: More conservative, fewer correct matches overall; prompted by observed failures, not a pristine independent test.

response_grounding.interpretation: Small binary consistency evaluation with one false accept; not universal factuality proof.

actual_model_offline_integration.interpretation: Delivery/check acceptance is not semantic accuracy. Reply-target and query/time errors remain.

response_audit.limitation: Cannot reconstruct historical text from old hashes; no power-loss durability guarantee.

related_private_cpu_checks.scope: Related private Discord/runtime/worker tests, not the full repository or the public CPU slice.

actual_discord_replay.inputs: Existing private user messages replayed with original timestamps and isolated historical memory.
actual_discord_replay.response_quality: Short/repetitive; no quality score inferred from successful delivery.

known_limits: Reply-target selection remains weak (0/6 exact in the explicit reply subset).
Some query/period interpretation fails before generation.
Ordinary CHAT is outside the response-grounding guard.
CLARIFY review_complete representation differs between teacher and runtime inputs; causal impact unproven.
Original grounding training manifest omits one existing source hash; a later release manifest records the current hash without repairing training-time provenance.
No learned Minecraft action ranker or autonomous long-term planner was added.
